title: Greer's groups call up lights on a nearby Florida beach

plain: A man named Charles, who describes his own sighting on Jesse Michels's podcast, says that Steven Greer, a UFO activist, takes his groups to almost the same beach, about 40 minutes south of Cocoa Beach, Florida. According to Charles, Greer's groups go there to try to call up lights in the sky, which hints that the spot is a place where such things are said to show up.
